feat(support): package geometry as a plugin capability

Geometry properties now exist only while a geometry plugin is loaded:

- add PlateGeometryCapability (inspector model builder, default resize
  rules, selection frame outset) registered by the new PlateGeometryPlugin
  (id plate.geometry)
- PlateConfig.includeDefaultGeometryPlugin toggles the built-in plugin
  (default on); with the plugin disabled no x/y/width/height/rotation
  properties appear in the inspector
- default inspector renders the geometry section only when a geometry
  capability is loaded; PlateInspectorConfig.showGeometry now only hides
  it further
- resize-mode resolution falls back to the geometry capability before the
  controller's built-in inference; extract plateDefaultResizeModeForElement
  from the controller so both paths share one rule set
- selection frame outset falls back to the geometry capability
- example component-visibility page gains a "load geometry plugin" switch
  and gates the geometry-property switch on the plugin being loaded
- add plate_geometry_plugin_test covering capability registration, default
  resize rules, default assembly, plugin-disabled/showGeometry semantics,
  edit+undo, and renderer replacement
